# MEREM Health

> MEREM Health is a Birmingham-based healthcare revenue cycle management and medical billing solutions provider serving specialty practices and healthcare facilities.

Founded in 2008, MEREM Health specializes in comprehensive revenue cycle management, medical coding, billing, and consulting services for healthcare providers across multiple specialties. The company employs AAPC-certified coders and offers tailored solutions for practices ranging from small specialty offices to large hospital systems and ambulatory surgery centers.

## Key Topics

- Revenue Cycle Management
- Medical Billing
- Medical Coding
- Healthcare Consulting
- Claims Management
- Specialty Coding
- Medical Credentialing
- Practice Management
- AAPC Certification
- Healthcare Auditing
- Patient Collections
- Charge Optimization
- Ambulatory Surgery Centers
- Healthcare Outsourcing
- EMR Integration

## Core Services

- [Medical Billing Services](https://www.meremhealth.com/services/billing): Medical billing services with claim processing and payment posting solutions.
- [Medical Coding Services](https://www.meremhealth.com/services/coding): Customized medical coding services with AAPC-certified coders and audits.
- [Revenue Improvement](https://www.meremhealth.com/services/revenue-improvement): Revenue cycle management for charge optimization and cash flow maximization.
- [Medical Auditing Services](https://www.meremhealth.com/services/auditing): Confidential revenue cycle auditing and compliance services for healthcare practices.
- [Healthcare Consulting](https://www.meremhealth.com/services/consulting): Healthcare consulting with process optimization and EncounterCoach staff training.
- [Medical Credentialing](https://www.meremhealth.com/services/medical-credentialing): Provider credentialing and hospital privileging management services.
- [Patient Pre-Collections](https://www.meremhealth.com/services/patient-pre-collections): Patient pre-collections and point-of-service payment arrangement solutions.

## Specialty Solutions

- [Cardiology Solutions](https://www.meremhealth.com/specialties/cardiology): Cardiology and cardiothoracic procedure coding and billing solutions.
- [Gastroenterology Solutions](https://www.meremhealth.com/specialties/gastroenterology): Gastroenterology procedure coding and revenue cycle solutions.
- [General Surgery Solutions](https://www.meremhealth.com/specialties/general-surgery): General surgery procedure coding and billing management services.
- [Advanced Imaging and Radiology Solutions](https://www.meremhealth.com/specialties/advanced-imaging-radiology): Specialized medical coding for advanced imaging and radiology procedures.
- [Hematology and Oncology Solutions](https://www.meremhealth.com/specialties/hematology-oncology): Hematology and oncology procedure coding and billing services.
- [Dermatology Solutions](https://www.meremhealth.com/specialties/dermatology): Dermatology procedure coding and billing services for specialty practices.
- [ENT Solutions](https://www.meremhealth.com/specialties/ent): ENT and maxillofacial surgery coding and billing solutions.
- [Hospital and ASC Facility Solutions](https://www.meremhealth.com/specialties/hospital-asc-facility): Hospital and ambulatory surgery center coding and facility billing solutions.
